text:
elena: KiteBridge pilot — quick sync? Need to finalize POC scope, baseline prompts, and success criteria. They've asked for cost estimate + security checklist by EOW. @ajay @kevin

ajay: 30m today? I'm free 14:00 PT. For success criteria propose: 1) intent accuracy >= 88% on our eval set; 2) 95th pctile latency <= 250ms; 3) cost per 1k tokens <= $0.9 hosted equivalent. Open to adjust based on model choice.

kevin: Quick Q — which model family are we targeting for the POC? If we go with rlnet-13B (q4) we can hit quality but cost is higher. rlnet-6B quantized looks promising for latency/cost. Need eval to measure tradeoffs.

tess: Security flag: KiteBridge ingests PII in prompts. Requirements: EU data residency, KMS for keys, SSO + MFA. I'll start the security questionnaire but need a simple data flow diagram and example payloads.

chris: Product ask: also measure hallucination rate (false facts) on a 50-sample challenge set + prompt sensitivity (drop in accuracy under paraphrase). Recommend baseline prompt bundle: 8 intents x ~30 paraphrases each.

elena: I'll own the prompt inventory. Quick first-pass draft below, feel free to edit.

```
# baseline prompts (intent,label)
"Summarize this customer email and extract next steps." -> summary_actions
"Draft a short policy update email to customers about rate changes." -> policy_draft
"Classify sentiment: positive / neutral / negative." -> sentiment
"Given this support conversation, recommend escalation or not." -> escalate_flag
```

ajay: We'll wire up an automated eval harness. Example CLI to run local eval: 

```
ri-eval run --model rlnet-13b-q4 --dataset kitebridge_eval.jsonl \\--metrics accuracy,latency,hallucination \\--concurrency 8
```

kevin: Notes for infra: set BATCH=4, MAX_TOK=512. If 95p latency > 300ms we'll auto-fallback to rlnet-6B. Also planning a quantization-impact test (q4_0 vs q2 / q4_k) to measure quality delta.

tess: Also add contract blockers: NDA + DPA must be signed before Private deployment. Need IdP metadata for SSO and the legal team will require the app data retention plan.

elena: Action items (quick):
1) elena - full prompt inventory + 1st-pass eval by Wed
2) ajay - cost estimate & experiment plan by Thu
3) kevin - run quantization impact test and share latency matrix
4) tess - security questionnaire answers + DPA checklist by Fri
5) chris & mason - pricing ranges and Dedicated vs Hosted recommendation

ajay: :thumbsup: I can do the cost experiments and write up the plan.

kevin: :white_check_mark: kicking off quant tests now, will post results in this thread.

tess: Acknowledged. I'll ping legal for the DPA template and post the questionnaire draft.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "KiteBridge POC scoping" Thu 14:00 PT — https://cal.link/kitebridge-poc

mason: On pricing — I'll put together a short one-pager with ranges (Hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved GPU hour estimates) and send to elena by Thu EOD.

chris: One more product note: if the customer requires Dedicated we should pre-quote 99.9% SLA + commit window. I'll draft recommended commit tiers (low/med/high).

elena: Thanks all — looping in @mason for pricing sync and @legal for DPA signoff. If there are no objections I'll run the first eval on Wed and share results.

mason: Acknowledged, will coordinate with elena.

elena: ack — closing the loop here for now, will post updates as items complete.
